subject.title: fix(secrets): collect persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs

question: Should this persona SecretRef activation land only after or alongside the optional-TTS missing-credential degradation work, or should current eager fail-fast secrets behavior apply immediately to persona TTS paths?
rationale: Both outcomes are internally coherent, but they produce different upgrade behavior for existing configurations and the repository has an active product discussion specifically about optional TTS startup failure.

options.title: Sequence with TTS degradation
options.body: Land this PR after or together with an accepted narrow missing-TTS degradation path so persona SecretRefs resolve when present without making an absent optional key fatal to Gateway startup.

options.title: Accept eager fail-fast
options.body: Land this PR independently and explicitly accept that any active missing persona TTS SecretRef blocks startup under the current general secrets contract.

options.title: Pause for combined proof
options.body: Hold this PR until exact-head live proof demonstrates both successful persona injection and the chosen missing-key startup behavior.

recommendation.title: Sequence with TTS degradation
recommendation.body: Land this PR after or together with an accepted narrow missing-TTS degradation path so persona SecretRefs resolve when present without making an absent optional key fatal to Gateway startup.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent SecretRef runtime and strictness work most closely matches the decision boundary between canonical resolution and startup compatibility.
